description: This file defines the ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt class, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using the mcrypt library within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes getter and setter methods for cipher, mode, and source, and handles encryption/decryption operations with IV generation.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt
classes.description: A class providing encryption and decryption functionalities using the PHP mcrypt extension, with configurable cipher, mode, and source.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Returns the current cipher method used for encryption.

methods.name: setCipher
methods.description: Sets the cipher method for encryption.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode used for encryption.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source for IV generation.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source for IV generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cipher, mode, and source with optional parameters, defaulting to specific mcrypt constants if not provided.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data with a given key using mcrypt, generating an IV based on the source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data with a given key using mcrypt, generating an IV based on the source, and trims null bytes.
